## A: BIOLOG 碳源利用热图

### 数据准备

```{r}
#| label: biolog-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

# 读取碳源利用数据
df_carbon <- read_csv("data/processed/biolog/df_biolog_pb_carbon.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 读取孔位映射
well_mapping <- read_csv("data/processed/biolog/well_mapping_biolog.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
well_mapping_en <- setNames(well_mapping$Name_EN, well_mapping$Well)

# 筛选碳源利用区（列 1-9）并排除阴性对照 A1
wells_carbon <- well_mapping$Well[!grepl("10|11|12$", well_mapping$Well)]
wells_carbon <- wells_carbon[wells_carbon != "A1"]

# 构建热图矩阵：48h 最大 OD590（扣背景后）
heatmap_data <- df_carbon |>
  filter(Time == 48, Well %in% wells_carbon) |>
  group_by(Strain, Genus, Replicate, Well) |>
  summarise(OD = max(OD590_corrected, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = Well, values_from = OD, values_fill = 0) |>
  as.data.frame()

rownames(heatmap_data) <- paste(heatmap_data$Strain, heatmap_data$Replicate, sep = "_")

# 构建矩阵并替换列名为英文碳源名
heatmap_mat <- as.matrix(heatmap_data[, intersect(wells_carbon, colnames(heatmap_data))])
colnames(heatmap_mat) <- well_mapping_en[colnames(heatmap_mat)]

# 行注释：属信息
row_ann <- data.frame(Genus = heatmap_data$Genus, row.names = rownames(heatmap_data))
ann_colors <- list(
  Genus = setNames(c("#4DBBD5", "#E64B35"), c("Pantoea", "Burkholderia"))
)

```

### 热图

```{r}
#| label: fig-biolog-heatmap
#| fig-cap: "Pantoea 与 Burkholderia 碳源利用热图（Biolog GENIII，48h 扣背景后 OD590）"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 7
#| warning: false
#| message: false

f5a <- pheatmap(heatmap_mat,
         annotation_row = row_ann, annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = TRUE,
         treeheight_row = 25, treeheight_col = 25,
         fontsize_col = 6, fontsize_row = 8,
         cellwidth = 9, cellheight = 11,
         border_color = NA, silent = TRUE) |>
  ggplotify::as.ggplot()

f5a
```

**Pantoea** 偏向利用植物来源糖类（麦芽糖、蜜二糖、乳糖、棉子糖）和果胶降解产物（半乳糖醛酸、葡萄糖醛酸）；**Burkholderia** 偏向利用氨基酸（精氨酸、天冬氨酸、丝氨酸）、有机酸（丙酸、丁酸类）和糖醇（山梨醇、岩藻糖），体现不同的碳源代谢偏好。

## B: 代谢组差异分析

### 数据准备

```{r}
#| label: metabolomics-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(readxl)
library(ggVennDiagram)
library(ggrepel)

# 读取代谢组差异数据
meta_all <- bind_rows(
  read_xlsx("data/processed/rna-seq/Burkholderia/meta/BG_vs_CK_filter.xlsx") |> mutate(strain = "Burkholderia"),
  read_xlsx("data/processed/rna-seq/Pantoea/meta/PS_vs_CK_filter.xlsx") |> mutate(strain = "Pantoea")
) |>
  mutate(
    strain = factor(strain, levels = c("Pantoea", "Burkholderia")),
    direction = case_when(
      Log2FC < 0 ~ "Consumed",
      Log2FC > 0 ~ "Produced",
      TRUE ~ "Neutral"
    )
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0))) |>
  filter(Level %in% c("1a", "1b", "2"))

# 置信差异代谢物筛选：VIP ≥ 1, FDR < 0.05
meta_all_sig <- meta_all |>
  filter(VIP >= 1, FDR < 0.05)
```

### B1: PCA 分析

```{r}
#| label: metabolomics-pca
#| warning: false
#| message: false

# PCA 输入
expr <- meta_all |> select(bg_1:bg_3, ck_1:ck_3, ps_1:ps_3)
expr_t <- t(expr)
colnames(expr_t) <- meta_all$Compounds
pca <- prcomp(expr_t, scale. = TRUE)

# 样本注释
sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample = c(paste0("bg_", 1:3), paste0("ck_", 1:3), paste0("ps_", 1:3)),
  strain = factor(c(rep("Burkholderia", 3), rep("Seed Metabolite", 3), rep("Pantoea", 3)),
                   levels = c("Pantoea", "Burkholderia", "Seed Metabolite"))
)

pca_df <- data.frame(pca$x, sample = rownames(pca$x)) |>
  left_join(sample_info, by = "sample")

var_explained <- round(summary(pca)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100, 1)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-metabolomics-pca
#| fig-cap: "Pantoea 与 Burkholderia 代谢物谱 PCA 分析"
#| fig-width: 5
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false

f5b1 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = strain)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Pantoea" = "#4DBBD5", "Burkholderia" = "#E64B35", "Seed Metabolite" = "#999999")) +
  labs(
    x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "%)"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.4, 0.6)
  )

f5b1
```

### B2: 火山图

```{r}
#| label: fig-metabolomics-volcano
#| fig-cap: "Pantoea 与 Burkholderia 代谢物差异火山图（VIP ≥ 1, FDR < 0.05）"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 4
#| warning: false

# 构建火山图数据
volcano_df <- meta_all |>
  mutate(
    negLogFDR = -log10(FDR + 1e-300),
    sig = case_when(
      VIP >= 1 & FDR < 0.05 & Log2FC > 0 ~ "Produced",
      VIP >= 1 & FDR < 0.05 & Log2FC < 0 ~ "Consumed",
      TRUE ~ "NotSig"
    )
  )

# 统计标签
stats_df <- volcano_df |>
  group_by(strain) |>
  summarise(
    up = sum(sig == "Produced"),
    down = sum(sig == "Consumed"),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    up_text = paste0("Produced: ", up),
    down_text = paste0("Consumed: ", down)
  )

make_volcano <- function(df, st, st_label) {
  st_df <- filter(stats_df, strain == st)
  ggplot(subset(df, strain == st), aes(Log2FC, negLogFDR, color = sig)) +
    geom_point(data = subset(df, strain == st & VIP < 1), size = 0.4, alpha = 0.75, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_point(data = subset(df, strain == st & VIP >= 1), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.75) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Produced" = "#4575B4", "Consumed" = "#D73027", "NotSig" = "grey75"), name = NULL) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_text(data = st_df, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = down_text), color = "#D73027", fontface = "bold", size = 3, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    geom_text(data = st_df, aes(x = Inf, y = Inf, label = up_text), color = "#4575B4", fontface = "bold", size = 3, hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.2))) +
    labs(x = "Log2 Fold Change", y = expression(-log[10](FDR)), subtitle = st_label) +
    theme_pub()
}

volcano_p1 <- make_volcano(volcano_df, "Pantoea", "Pantoea") + theme(legend.position = "none")
volcano_p2 <- make_volcano(volcano_df, "Burkholderia", "Burkholderia") +
  theme(legend.position = "inside",
  legend.position.inside = c(0.7, 0.85))
f5b2 <- volcano_p1 | volcano_p2
f5b2
```

### B3: 韦恩图

```{r}
#| label: fig-metabolomics-venn
#| fig-cap: "Pantoea 与 Burkholderia 差异代谢物四组 Venn 图（Consumed × Produced）"
#| fig-width: 4
#| fig-height: 3
#| warning: false

# 构建四组集合：Pantoea_Consumed, Pantoea_Produced, Burkholderia_Consumed, Burkholderia_Produced
four_sets <- meta_all_sig |>
  filter(direction != "Neutral") |>
  mutate(group = paste(strain, direction, sep = "_")) |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(compounds = list(unique(Compounds)), .groups = "drop")

four_list <- setNames(four_sets$compounds, four_sets$group)
# 固定顺序以便图例清晰
four_list <- four_list[c("Pantoea_Consumed", "Pantoea_Produced",
                          "Burkholderia_Consumed", "Burkholderia_Produced")]

f5b3 <- ggVennDiagram(
  four_list,
  label = "count",
  label_alpha = 0,
  category.names = c("Pantoea\nConsumed", "Pantoea\nProduced",
                     "Burkholderia\nConsumed", "Burkholderia\nProduced")
) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "#B85450")

f5b3
```

### B4: 代表性差异代谢物条形图

```{r}
#| label: fig-metabolomics-barplot
#| fig-cap: "Pantoea 与 Burkholderia 代表性差异代谢物（Top VIP ∩ Top |Log2FC|）"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 6
#| warning: false

# Top50 VIP 与 Top50 |Log2FC| 交集
top_vip <- meta_all_sig |>
  group_by(strain) |>
  slice_max(order_by = VIP, n = 50, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(strain, Compounds)

top_fc <- meta_all_sig |>
  group_by(strain) |>
  slice_max(order_by = abs(Log2FC), n = 50, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(strain, Compounds)

top_df <- inner_join(top_vip, top_fc, by = c("strain", "Compounds")) |>
  left_join(meta_all_sig, by = c("strain", "Compounds")) |>
  arrange(strain, desc(abs(Log2FC)))

# 排除与论文主线关联较弱的代谢物
remove_metabolites <- c(
  "Glu-Tyr", "Val-Tyr", "Oglufanide",
  "4-Methoxybenzaldehyde", "Ethyl 3,4-dihydroxybenzoate"
)

top_df_clean <- top_df |>
  filter(!Compounds %in% remove_metabolites)

f5b4 <- ggplot(top_df_clean, aes(x = reorder(Compounds, Log2FC), y = Log2FC, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~strain, scales = "free_x") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Produced" = "#4575B4", "Consumed" = "#D73027"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Log2 Fold Change") +
  theme_pub(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

f5b4
```

**代谢组小结：** Pantoea 以消耗可溶性糖（葡萄糖、果糖）和氨基酸（脯氨酸、酪氨酸）为主；Burkholderia 底物谱更广，消耗氨基酸（谷氨酸、缬氨酸）、有机酸和芳香族化合物，并积累羟基丁酸等代谢中间产物。两菌在苹果酸等核心碳源上存在共同消耗，但整体代谢策略呈现明显分化。

## C: 转录组 KEGG 通路富集

### 数据准备与 GSEA 分析

```{r}
#| label: transcriptomics-data
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(gson)
library(clusterProfiler)

# 读取 DESeq2 结果
res_pan <- read_csv("data/processed/rna-seq/pantoea_DeSeq2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
res_bur <- read_csv("data/processed/rna-seq/burkholderia_DeSeq2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 读取 KEGG gson
kegg_pan <- read.gson("data/prep/lanc-kegg-pathway/gson/Pantoea-kegg-pathway.gson")
kegg_bur <- read.gson("data/prep/lanc-kegg-pathway/gson/Burkholderia-kegg-pathway.gson")

# 清洗基因 ID
clean_id <- function(x) {
  x <- sub(".*:", "", x)
  x <- sub("\\.t[0-9]+$", "", x)
  x
}

# 构建 GSEA 输入
make_gene_list <- function(res_df) {
  idx <- !is.na(res_df$log2FoldChange)
  geneList <- res_df$log2FoldChange[idx]
  names(geneList) <- clean_id(res_df$gene_id[idx])
  sort(geneList, decreasing = TRUE)
}

# GSEA 主函数
run_gsea <- function(gson_data, res_df, pvalueCutoff = 0.05) {
  geneList <- make_gene_list(res_df)
  if (length(geneList) < 50) return(NULL)
  GSEA(
    geneList = geneList, gson = gson_data,
    minGSSize = 10, maxGSSize = 2000,
    pvalueCutoff = pvalueCutoff,
    verbose = FALSE
  )
}

# 运行 GSEA
gsea_pan <- run_gsea(kegg_pan, res_pan)
gsea_bur <- run_gsea(kegg_bur, res_bur)

# 提取结果
extract_gsea_df <- function(gsea_res, species_name) {
  if (is.null(gsea_res)) return(NULL)
  df <- as.data.frame(gsea_res)
  if (nrow(df) == 0) return(NULL)
  df |> transmute(Description, Species = species_name, NES, setSize)
}

df_pan <- extract_gsea_df(gsea_pan, "Pantoea")
df_bur <- extract_gsea_df(gsea_bur, "Burkholderia")

# 过滤噪音通路
noise_pattern <- paste(
  "disease", "cancer", "atherosclerosis", "Tuberculosis", "Parkinson", "Thermogenesis",
  "Cell cycle - Caulobacter", "Biofilm formation - Pseudomonas aeruginosa",
  sep = "|"
)
df_pan <- df_pan[!grepl(noise_pattern, df_pan$Description, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
df_bur <- df_bur[!grepl(noise_pattern, df_bur$Description, ignore.case = TRUE), ]

# 构建通路 × 菌全集
all_desc <- unique(c(df_pan$Description, df_bur$Description))
gsea_df_all <- expand.grid(Description = all_desc, Species = c("Pantoea", "Burkholderia"),
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  left_join(bind_rows(df_pan, df_bur), by = c("Description", "Species")) |>
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Pantoea", "Burkholderia")),
    Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(all_desc))
  )
```

### KEGG 通路富集 Dotplot

```{r}
#| label: fig-transcriptomics-kegg-dotplot
#| fig-cap: "Pantoea 与 Burkholderia KEGG 通路 GSEA 富集比较"
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 2.5
#| warning: false

# 翻转版本：Species 在 Y 轴，通路在 X 轴
gsea_df_all_flip <- gsea_df_all
gsea_df_all_flip$Species <- factor(
  gsea_df_all_flip$Species,
  levels = rev(c("Pantoea", "Burkholderia"))
)

# 绘制无图例的主图
p_kegg_flip <- ggplot(
  gsea_df_all_flip,
  aes(x = Description, y = Species, size = setSize, color = NES)
) +
  geom_point() +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "#4575B4", mid = "#F7F7F7", high = "#D73027",
                        midpoint = 0, name = "NES") +
  scale_size(range = c(2, 8), name = "Gene set size") +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("Pantoea" = expression(italic("Pantoea")),
                              "Burkholderia" = expression(italic("Burkholderia")))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_pub() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, size = 7),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "none",
    plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 80, b = 5, l = 5, unit = "pt")
  )

# 分别提取两个图例（隐藏另一个避免重复）
legend_nes <- cowplot::get_legend(
  p_kegg_flip + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(
      color = guide_colorbar(title = "NES", barwidth = 8, barheight = 0.8),
      size = "none"
    )
)
legend_size <- cowplot::get_legend(
  p_kegg_flip + theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    guides(
      color = "none",
      size = guide_legend(title = "Gene set size", nrow = 1)
    )
)

# 组合图例：NES 在上，Size 在下
combined_legend <- cowplot::plot_grid(legend_nes, legend_size, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 1))

# 主图（不含图例）
f5c <- p_kegg_flip
f5c
```

**转录组小结：** Pantoea 富集于 Ribosome、Biosynthesis of amino acids、Carbon metabolism 等基础代谢和生长相关通路，支持其快速生长策略；Burkholderia 富集于 Flagellar assembly、Bacterial chemotaxis、Two-component system、Quorum sensing 等环境感知和群体行为相关通路，体现其优先启动环境适应机制而非快速增殖的策略。

### DEG List

```{r}
#| label: tbl-deg-list
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(DT)

# 读取基因注释（gene_name, product）
annot_pan <- read_csv("data/processed/rna-seq/pantoea_gene_annotations.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
annot_bur <- read_csv("data/processed/rna-seq/burkholderia_gene_annotations.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 读取 DEG 数据并关联注释
# gene_id 格式：DESeq2 为 ACSMXK_00005.t01，注释为 ACSMXK_00005，去掉 .tXX 后缀匹配
deg_pan <- read_csv("data/processed/rna-seq/pantoea_DeSeq2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(gene_id = sub("\\.t[0-9]+$", "", gene_id)) |>
  left_join(annot_pan, by = c("gene_id" = "gene_id")) |>
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name, product, log2FoldChange, padj) |>
  arrange(padj)

deg_bur <- read_csv("data/processed/rna-seq/burkholderia_DeSeq2.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(gene_id = sub("\\.t[0-9]+$", "", gene_id)) |>
  left_join(annot_bur, by = c("gene_id" = "gene_id")) |>
  dplyr::select(gene_id, gene_name, product, log2FoldChange, padj) |>
  arrange(padj)
```

```{r}
#| label: deg-export-excel
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(openxlsx)

deg_pan_filtered <- deg_pan |> filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 2)
deg_bur_filtered <- deg_bur |> filter(abs(log2FoldChange) > 2)

dir.create("output/tables", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

write.xlsx(
  list(
    Pantoea = deg_pan_filtered,
    Burkholderia = deg_bur_filtered
  ),
  "output/tables/DEG_log2FC2.xlsx"
)
```

## 综合讨论

Pantoea 与 Burkholderia 在碳源利用、代谢重塑和转录响应三个层面均表现出显著的生态位分化：

| 层面 | Pantoea | Burkholderia |
|------|---------|--------------|
| **BIOLOG 碳源利用** | 植物来源糖类（麦芽糖、蜜二糖、乳糖）和果胶降解产物 | 氨基酸（精氨酸、天冬氨酸）、有机酸（丙酸、丁酸类）和糖醇 |
| **代谢组 Consumed** | 可溶性糖（葡萄糖、果糖）和氨基酸（脯氨酸、酪氨酸） | 氨基酸（谷氨酸、缬氨酸）、有机酸和芳香族化合物 |
| **代谢组 Produced** | 较少特异性产物 | 羟基丁酸等代谢中间产物 |
| **转录组富集** | Ribosome、Amino acid biosynthesis、Carbon metabolism | Flagellar assembly、Chemotaxis、Quorum sensing |
| **生态策略** | 植物碳源依赖型，快速生长 | 广谱有机质利用型，环境适应优先 |

这种多层次的代谢分化表明，两菌在种子微生物组中可能通过资源利用差异实现生态位分离，降低直接竞争并促进共存。
